description:
Find out if agents can actually pay you. Free check of an x402 seller endpoint (Seller Check). Sends only unpaid requests: confirms the route answers HTTP 402, reads the challenge (header and body, v1 or v2), checks every accepts entry (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo, maxTimeoutSeconds, and extra.name/extra.version against the token's real EIP-712 domain), the named payment service's /supported, and /pricing, /openapi.json, /.well-known/x402 for consistency.

Args:
    url: https URL of the paid route (required).
    method: "GET" or "POST" (optional; default from the seller's OpenAPI file, else GET).
    body: optional JSON body for POST routes (max 8 KB).
Returns checked_at, overall (pass|warn|fail) and checks[] with status, reason and a fix hint. Never pays. Limits: 10 checks per caller per hour, 3 per host per hour.
name: check_x402_endpoint
